# Catalog

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:catalog` from the registry manifests. Do not edit. -->

43 modules · 28 sections · 29 UI primitives · 8 presets · 4 themes

Add anything below to a project with `pnpm site add <name>` (sections as `section:<name>`,
primitives as `ui:<name>`). Each module's README is copied into the project at
`.site/modules/<name>.md`.

## Presets

| Preset | What you get | Modules | Theme |
| ------ | ------------ | ------- | ----- |
| `agency` | A studio site: services, case studies, process, testimonials and a contact form that lands in your inbox. | `seo`, `analytics`, `ci`, `vercel`, `cookie-consent`, `legal`, `case-studies`, `contact`, `testimonials`, `blog` | playful |
| `blog` | A writing-first site: posts with tags, RSS and OG images, an about page and a newsletter. | `seo`, `analytics`, `ci`, `vercel`, `blog`, `newsletter`, `about`, `legal` | editorial |
| `digital-store` | Sell templates, guides or presets: product pages, Stripe checkout, emailed download links and a newsletter. | `seo`, `analytics`, `ci`, `vercel`, `cookie-consent`, `legal`, `store`, `newsletter`, `faq` | neutral |
| `docs` | Product documentation with sidebar navigation, search and a changelog. | `seo`, `analytics`, `ci`, `vercel`, `docs`, `changelog` | terminal |
| `landing` | One page that explains, convinces and converts: hero, benefits, proof, FAQ, newsletter and contact. | `seo`, `analytics`, `ci`, `vercel`, `cookie-consent`, `legal`, `contact`, `newsletter`, `faq`, `testimonials` | playful |
| `portfolio` | Personal site for makers: projects, about and résumé, writing, a now page, gallery and a link-in-bio page. | `seo`, `analytics`, `ci`, `vercel`, `projects`, `about`, `now`, `gallery`, `links`, `blog`, `contact` | editorial |
| `saas` | A subscription product: marketing site, sign-up, dashboard, billing, teams, admin, API keys and onboarding. | `seo`, `analytics`, `ci`, `vercel`, `cookie-consent`, `legal`, `contact`, `blog`, `changelog`, `faq`, `testimonials`, `auth`, `dashboard`, `settings`, `billing`, `teams`, `admin`, `notifications`, `transactional-emails`, `onboarding`, `api` | neutral |
| `waitlist` | Pre-launch page that collects sign-ups with referral positions, plus the basics you need to go live. | `seo`, `analytics`, `ci`, `vercel`, `cookie-consent`, `legal`, `waitlist`, `faq` | playful |

`npx @site-forge/create-site my-site --preset <name>`

## Modules

### SEO & operations

| Module | Description | Requires | Env | Routes |
| ------ | ----------- | -------- | --- | ------ |
| [`analytics`](../registry/modules/analytics/README.md) | One track() for Plausible, PostHog, Google Analytics 4 or Umami, chosen by env vars; waits for cookie consent when the provider needs it; logs events locally in dev. | – | 7 | – |
| [`ci`](../registry/modules/ci/README.md) | Lint, typecheck, test and build on every push and pull request, with cached installs and Next.js builds, least-privilege tokens and grouped Dependabot updates. | – | – | – |
| [`docker`](../registry/modules/docker/README.md) | Self-host anywhere: a small multi-stage image (standalone output, non-root, health check) and a compose file with optional Postgres and migrations. | – | – | `/api/health` |
| [`i18n`](../registry/modules/i18n/README.md) | next-intl without locale prefixes in URLs: the language comes from a cookie or the browser, with a switcher, typed messages and <html lang> kept in sync. | – | – | – |
| [`maintenance`](../registry/modules/maintenance/README.md) | Switch the site to a proper 503 page from an env var or a scheduled window, with a bypass link for your team and an advance-notice banner. | – | 3 | – |
| [`sentry`](../registry/modules/sentry/README.md) | Sentry for server, edge and browser errors, React error boundaries and request errors, tunnelled through your own domain; inert until a DSN is set. | – | 4 | – |
| [`seo`](../registry/modules/seo/README.md) | sitemap.xml, robots.txt (no-index outside production), JSON-LD helpers and generated Open Graph images. | – | – | `/sitemap.xml`, `/robots.txt`, `/opengraph-image` |
| [`vercel`](../registry/modules/vercel/README.md) | vercel.json that checks production env vars before building, security-minded defaults, and a step-by-step deploy guide. | – | – | – |

## Sections

| Section | Group | Description |
| ------- | ----- | ----------- |
| `auth-card` | Application | Centered or split-screen frame for sign-in, sign-up and reset flows. |
| `dashboard-shell` | Application | App layout: sidebar nav with active state, topbar, mobile drawer via the Popover API. |
| `empty-state` | Application | Icon, message and next actions for empty lists and first-run screens. |
| `blog-list` | Content | Post cards as a grid or a compact list, with dates, tags and reading time. |
| `faq` | Content | Questions as native <details> (exclusive, zero JS), with optional side intro. |
| `page-header` | Content | Title block for inner pages with eyebrow, description, breadcrumbs and actions. |
| `project-grid` | Content | Portfolio projects with images, years and tags. |
| `team` | Content | People with photos, roles and links. |
| `timeline` | Content | Vertical sequence of dated milestones. |
| `contact-section` | Conversion | Intro, contact details and a slot for any form. |
| `cta-band` | Conversion | Closing call to action; inverted, muted or bordered. |
| `newsletter-band` | Conversion | Signup band with a slot for the form and a privacy note. |
| `bento-grid` | Features | Asymmetric grid of feature tiles in five sizes, with media slots. |
| `feature-grid` | Features | 2–4 column grid of features with icons and optional links. |
| `feature-rows` | Features | Alternating media/text rows with bullets and actions. |
| `section-kit` | Foundation | Shared building blocks for every section: Section wrapper with tones, SectionHeader, actions, media types. |
| `hero-centered` | Hero | Centered headline, lead, actions and optional media below. |
| `hero-media` | Hero | Headline over a full-bleed image or video with a token-based scrim. |
| `hero-split` | Hero | Copy on one side, media on the other; stacks on mobile. |
| `footer-columns` | Navigation | Brand block, link columns, legal row and socials. |
| `footer-minimal` | Navigation | A single quiet row: name, links, copyright. |
| `navbar-centered` | Navigation | Links centered between logo and actions; popover menu on mobile. |
| `navbar-floating` | Navigation | Detached, rounded bar that floats over the page; popover menu on mobile. |
| `navbar-simple` | Navigation | Logo, links and actions in one row; popover menu on mobile. |
| `pricing-table` | Pricing | Plans with monthly/yearly toggle (CSS-only, no JS), features and CTAs. Reads plans from config. |
| `logo-cloud` | Social proof | Row of customer or partner logos with an optional caption. |
| `stats` | Social proof | Key numbers with labels, as a row or a bordered grid. |
| `testimonials` | Social proof | Quote cards in a masonry-like grid, with an optional featured quote. |

## UI primitives

| Primitive | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `accordion` | Collapsible sections with single or multiple open items (Radix). |
| `alert` | Inline message for info, success, warning and errors, announced to screen readers. |
| `avatar` | Image avatar with initials fallback while loading or on error. |
| `badge` | Small status label with neutral, outline and semantic variants. |
| `button` | Button with variants and sizes; renders any element via asChild (links, triggers). |
| `card` | Surface for grouped content: header, title, description, content, footer. |
| `checkbox` | Accessible checkbox (Radix) that submits with native forms. |
| `copy-button` | Button that copies a value to the clipboard and confirms it, announced to screen readers. |
| `dialog` | Modal dialog (Radix): focus trap, Esc to close, scroll lock. |
| `dropdown-menu` | Menu with keyboard navigation, checkable items and sub-menus (Radix). |
| `field` | Accessible form field: wires label, description and error to any control via ids. |
| `input` | Text input styled with tokens; supports aria-invalid and file inputs. |
| `kbd` | Keyboard key hint, e.g. ⌘K. |
| `label` | Native form label (no client JS) that dims with a disabled peer. |
| `native-select` | Styled native <select>: zero JS, best mobile UX, works in any form. |
| `pagination` | Link-based pagination for server-rendered lists. |
| `popover` | Floating panel anchored to a trigger (Radix). |
| `progress` | Accessible progress bar (role=progressbar) with value and label. |
| `prose` | Typography for rendered Markdown/MDX, fully driven by theme tokens. |
| `radio-group` | Radio group with roving focus (Radix). |
| `separator` | Horizontal or vertical divider with correct separator semantics. |
| `sheet` | Slide-in panel from any edge, built on the Radix dialog. |
| `skeleton` | Loading placeholder that respects reduced motion. |
| `switch` | On/off toggle (Radix) that submits with native forms. |
| `table` | Responsive data table parts with horizontal scrolling on small screens. |
| `tabs` | Tabbed views with automatic keyboard support (Radix). |
| `textarea` | Multi-line text input that grows with its content where supported. |
| `toaster` | Toast notifications (sonner) styled with tokens. Mount <Toaster /> once. |
| `tooltip` | Hover/focus hint for icon buttons (Radix). |

## Themes

| Theme | Description |
| ----- | ----------- |
| `editorial` | Warm paper, ink-black type, a serif display face and generous, slow rhythm. Square corners. |
| `neutral` | Plain grayscale with Geist. A blank canvas: no personality until you add one. |
| `playful` | Candy-pink surfaces, a violet accent, pillowy radii, bouncy motion and a chunky grotesk display face. |
| `terminal` | Monospace everything, phosphor-green accent, zero radius, no shadows, near-instant motion, compact density. |

Switch with `pnpm site theme <name>`, or tune the dials in `/lab` (theme-lab module).
